related.title: 拉曼顯微光譜儀
related.transfer: 可遷移「干涉圖與光譜的傅立葉對」與「波數校正與光闌引起的刻度誤差」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；拉曼顯微光譜儀的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "The interferogram–spectrum Fourier pair" and "Wavenumber calibration and aperture-induced scale error" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Raman microspectrometers must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦麥克森干涉儀、氦氖取樣、解析度與訊雜比交換的 FTIR 工程；拉曼顯微光譜儀則以拉曼位移、共軛焦取樣、瑞利光抑制、光柵色散、波數校正與雷射加熱預算為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on michelson interferometer, HeNe sampling, resolution and signal-to-noise trade-offs in FTIR engineering; Raman microspectrometers centres on raman shift, confocal sampling, Rayleigh rejection, grating dispersion, wavenumber calibration and laser-heating budgets, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「麥克森干涉儀與干涉圖」與「雷射線與斯托克斯散射光」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到拉曼顯微光譜儀，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「螢光背景、散粒雜訊與激發波長選擇」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Michelson interferometer and interferogram” and “Laser line and Stokes-scattered light”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Raman microspectrometers, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Fluorescence background, shot noise and excitation choice", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

以「Abbe 誤差、餘弦誤差與幾何誤差預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 傅立葉轉換紅外光譜儀
history.text: 麥克森在 1880 年代建立干涉儀並用它分析譜線的精細結構，但把干涉圖轉成光譜需要大量計算；直到 1949 年費爾蓋特指出多工優勢、1954 年雅基諾指出通量優勢，以及 1965 年 Cooley–Tukey 快速傅立葉轉換問世，FTIR 才在 1960 年代末由 Digilab 等公司商品化。1970–80 年代以氦氖雷射取樣與迷你電腦為基礎的桌上型儀器讓 FTIR 取代色散式紅外光譜儀，成為今日化學、材料與製藥實驗室的標準設備；本課只重建公開的儀器原理與驗證方法。
history.textEn: Michelson built his interferometer in the 1880s and used it to analyse spectral fine structure, but turning interferograms into spectra demanded heavy computation; only after Fellgett identified the multiplex advantage in 1949, Jacquinot the throughput advantage in 1954, and the Cooley–Tukey fast Fourier transform appeared in 1965 did companies such as Digilab commercialise FTIR in the late 1960s. Bench-top instruments built on HeNe-laser sampling and minicomputers in the 1970s and 1980s displaced dispersive infrared spectrometers, making FTIR standard equipment in chemistry, materials and pharmaceutical laboratories; this course reconstructs only public instrument principles and verification methods.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「干涉圖與光譜的傅立葉對」到「性能驗證、驗收準則與工程交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "The interferogram–spectrum Fourier pair" through "Performance qualification, acceptance criteria and handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
